ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-3 Neighborhood
Shopping District; B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 15-G in the area bounded by:

      North Winthrop Avenue; a line 57.76 feet south of and parallel to West Granville Avenue; the alley next
      west of and parallel to North Winthrop Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Granville
      Avenue; the east right-of-way line of the Paradise and Pacific Railroad; and a line 100 feet north of and
      parallel to West Granville Avenue,

to those of a B3-5, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.



                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Leni Manaa-Hoppenworth
                                                          Alderwoman, 48th Ward




Common Addresses:
1100-1110 W. Granville Avenue
1113-1117 W. Granville Avenue
6172 N. Winthrop Avenue
